title: Fibre dimensions are preserved by base change
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let g:S'\to S be a morphism of schemes, and form the cartesian square X'=X\times_S S' [def-pc-fibre-product] with projection f':X'\to S' [def-pc-base-change]. For x'\in X' with image x\in X, put s'=f'(x') and s=f(x). Then the fibre (X')_{s'} [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is the base change of X_s along the residue-field map \kappa(s)\to\kappa(s') [def-weil-residue-field], and the local dimensions [def-kun-dimension] agree: \dim_{x'}((X')_{s'})=\dim_x(X_s).
